title: Consolidating the Kingdom - Az ország megszervezése
grammar: Az ispán és a vár: aki és amely

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe how the counties (vármegyék) and royal officials (ispánok) organized the kingdom.
I can explain what the tatárjárás (Mongol invasion of 1241-42) was and its main consequences.
I can describe IV. Béla's post-invasion reconstruction, including stone castle building.
I can use aki and amely to say who the ispán was and what the royal castle was.
I can name the county seat and say what belonged to the royal castle.
